claim_text: FOX 9 identified 48 Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases since 2020 in which courts ordered a combined $13.3 million in restitution; as of spring 2026, approximately $2.355 million (about 17.7%) had been repaid, leaving roughly $11 million outstanding.
normalized_claim: FOX 9's 48-case sample: ~$13.3M restitution ordered (2020-2026) vs ~$2.355M collected (spring 2026), ~17.7% collection rate.
qualifiers: Scope is FOX 9's own reviewed set of 48 cases since 2020, not stated to be exhaustive or identical in population to KSTP's 2019-forward MFCU-wide figures.
Do not sum or average this with claim-mfcu-restitution-ordered-vs-collected-2019-2026; see contradiction-restitution-collection-scope-kstp-vs-fox9.
